author: Inside Edition
description: Former Virginia Lieutenant Governor Justin Fairfax and his wife are dead in what officials say was a murder-suicide. It happened at their home in Annandale. The investigating Police Chief told media 47-year-old Fairfax shot his wife, Cerina, in one part of their home and then went to a different part of the home to shoot himself. Investigators say both of their teenage children were home at the time of the shooting. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Virginia Ex-Lt. Governor Justin Fairfax, Wife Dead In Murder-Suicide: Cops

author: Inside Edition
description: Surveillance video shows a school principal taking down a gunman who entered the school building in Oklahoma. Investigators say Pauls Valley High School principal, Kirk Moore, tackled the suspect, identified as Victor Lee Hawkins, 20. They say Hawkins entered the school and pointed a firearm at two students. While he didn't fire on them, they say he did shoot Principal Moore as he was tackling him to a bench. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Principal Shot While Taking Down Gunman Who Entered Oklahoma High School
